title: Oil Rubbed Bronze Pipeline Collection Extended 3-Post Grab Bar, 63-Inch Wall Mount ADA Compliant Iron Pipe, Allied Brass
body_html:
Finished in Oil Rubbed Bronze, create a safer, more accessible bathroom without giving up your industrial look—this extended grab bar is backed by a limited lifetime warranty, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any bathroom.

  • Oil Rubbed Bronze brings rich depth and character
  • Coordinates with other Pipeline pieces for a distinguished, heritage-inspired look
  • Choose from 19 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Match loft-inspired spaces with pipe-style bath accessories from the Pipeline collection
  • Count on lasting performance with a durable powder coat finish for corrosion-free and rust-free use

Why it lasts: Iron pipe construction and a protective powder coat finish are built for daily bathroom use.

Complete the look: Coordinate with matching pipeline pieces and other industrial bathroom hardware from the Pipeline collection.

Specs
- Product type: Grab bar (extended length, 3-post)
- Length: 63 in
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 63 x 3 x 3.58 in
- Projection: 3.58 in
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Weight capacity: 250 lb
- Material: Iron Pipe
- Style: Industrial
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
- Assembly required: No
meta_description: 63-inch wall mount grab bar with 3-post center support. ADA compliant, 250 lb capacity iron pipe design with powder coat finish. Limited lifetime warranty.
